name: WeatherNext Maintenance Planner Evaluation
description: Checks that the agent explains what it does, finds a grounded maintenance window for one site, and plans crews across sites with explicit uncertainty.

parts.text: Hello, what can you help me with?
Which day this week can the main crane lift at Whitelee go ahead, and how confident are you?
We have 2 crane crews this week for main component lifts. Which sites should they go to and when?
